scripts.title: AutoFarm
scripts.script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local targetPosition = Vector3.new(163, 95, -6315)

local enabled = false

-- ss
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 110)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 100)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25,25,25)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", frame)
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

-- ss
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
title.Text = "Teleport Panel"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 16

-- ss
local button = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 45)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 45)
button.Text = "TP: OFF"
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,40,40)
button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
button.TextSize = 14

local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", button)
btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

-- ss
local dragging = false
local dragInput, dragStart, startPos

frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = frame.Position
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale,
            startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale,
            startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

-- ss
button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    enabled = not enabled
    button.Text = enabled and "TP: ON" or "TP: OFF"
    button.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Color3.fromRGB(0,170,0) or Color3.fromRGB(40,40,40)
end)

-- Insert
UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if not gp and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Insert then
        frame.Visible = not frame.Visible
    end
end)

-- ss
local function teleportLoop(character)
    local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    while character.Parent do
        if enabled then
            root.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPosition)
        end
        task.wait(1)
    end
end

if player.Character then
    task.spawn(teleportLoop, player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    task.spawn(teleportLoop, char)
end)

scripts.title: wins auto farm
scripts.script:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "Auto Farm GUI by Sqilss",
    LoadingTitle = "Teleport + Auto Rebirth + Auto Walk",
    LoadingSubtitle = "by Sqilss",
    ConfigurationSaving = {
        Enabled = true,
        FolderName = "AutoFarmHub",
        FileName = "AutoConfig"
    },
    KeySystem = false
})

local Tab = Window:CreateTab("Main", 4483362458)

-- ==================== TELEPORT LOOP ====================
local teleportLoop = false
local teleportConnection = nil

local function startTeleportLoop()
    if teleportConnection then return end
    teleportConnection = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not teleportLoop then
            teleportConnection:Disconnect()
            teleportConnection = nil
            return
        end
        local char = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(155.33, 89.82, -3046.06)
        end
    end)
end

local ToggleTeleport = Tab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Win farm (On/Off)",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        teleportLoop = Value
        if Value then
            startTeleportLoop()
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Teleport Loop", Content = "Enabled - Constant teleport active", Duration = 5})
        else
            if teleportConnection then teleportConnection:Disconnect() teleportConnection = nil end
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Teleport Loop", Content = "Disabled", Duration = 4})
        end
    end,
})

-- ==================== AUTO REBIRTH ====================
local autoRebirth = false
local rebirthConnection = nil

local function startAutoRebirth()
    if rebirthConnection then return end
    rebirthConnection = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not autoRebirth then
            rebirthConnection:Disconnect()
            rebirthConnection = nil
            return
        end
        -- Fire the rebirth remote
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Packages.Net["RE/Rebirth"]:FireServer()
        end)
        if not success then
            warn("Rebirth remote failed: " .. tostring(err))
        end
    end)
end

local ToggleRebirth = Tab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Auto Rebirth (On/Off)",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        autoRebirth = Value
        if Value then
            startAutoRebirth()
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Auto Rebirth", Content = "Enabled - Rebirthing every frame", Duration = 5})
        else
            if rebirthConnection then rebirthConnection:Disconnect() rebirthConnection = nil end
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Auto Rebirth", Content = "Disabled", Duration = 4})
        end
    end,
})

-- ==================== AUTO WALK ====================
local autoWalk = false
local walkConnection = nil

local function startAutoWalk()
    if walkConnection then return end
    local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
    
    walkConnection = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not autoWalk then
            walkConnection:Disconnect()
            walkConnection = nil
            return
        end
        
        local character = player.Character
        if character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            local humanoid = character.Humanoid
            -- Move forward relative to camera (you can still turn with mouse)
            humanoid:Move(Vector3.new(0, 0, -1), true)
        end
    end)
end

local ToggleWalk = Tab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Auto Walk (On/Off)",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        autoWalk = Value
        if Value then
            startAutoWalk()
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Auto Walk", Content = "Enabled - Walking forward automatically", Duration = 5})
        else
            if walkConnection then walkConnection:Disconnect() walkConnection = nil end
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Auto Walk", Content = "Disabled", Duration = 4})
        end
    end,
})

-- ==================== ONE-TIME TELEPORT ====================
local Button = Tab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Teleport Once (to coords)",
    Callback = function()
        local char = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character or game.Players.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
        local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(155.33, 89.82, -3046.06)
        Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Teleported", Content = "One-time teleport done", Duration = 3})
    end,
})

Rayfield:Notify({
    Title = "GUI Loaded Successfully",
    Content = "Use the toggles for Auto Rebirth, Auto Walk & Teleport Loop",
    Duration = 6
})
